verdict.rationale: Unity documents first-party unattended automation, but it centers on builds and CI rather than general AI-driven background automations. Unity Build Automation runs CI builds for multiple platforms and connects to version control. The Editor and Player can run headless or from command-line arguments to automate workflows, and the Unity CLI targets automation and CI pipelines. The AI Assistant's 'automate workflows' via natural-language prompts is an interactive, prompt-driven capability, not a background one. Missing for 10: user-configurable autonomous or scheduled AI agent automations, background execution of AI Assistant tasks, and automations beyond build/CI pipelines.
